comments.text:
🌍 Could you live in a room so small that rolling over in bed means touching the toilet? That is everyday life in Hong Kong's coffin homes, and it is only one stop in this worst places to live documentary. 🏙 One of these 15 places sits a few blocks from billion-dollar towers in Los Angeles, and another runs a recycling system that beats most Western cities. We are not saying which one.
👉 Which one hit you harder: the coffin homes of Hong Kong or Skid Row in Los Angeles? Tell us in the comments 👇 and subscribe for the next journey around the world.
#WorstPlacesToLive #UrbanHells #SkidRow
